_comment: Tier-2: the problem_data section MUST include 'echo_level'; Kratos accesses it during stage initialisation without a default. Pitfall (kratos.structural_dynamics #7). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). This is the structural_dynamics copy of the claim; the linear_elasticity copy (#7 there) has its own fixture, echo_level_missing. Measured: Parameters('{"problem_name":"x"}')['echo_level'] raises RuntimeError 'Error: Getting a value that does not exist. entry string : echo_level' — a C++ Parameters::GetValue error, NOT a Python KeyError and not from RunSolutionLoop, exactly as this entry's corrected wording says. Adding the key makes the same lookup succeed. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
